violation_type.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))
violation_type.short_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles
violation_type.typical_finding: Infant was in a bouncer prop up with a bottle.

finding_variants.text: Infant was in a bouncer prop up with a bottle.

It was found while conducting the inspection that a 4 month old infant was in a bouncer drinking a bottle with the bottle propped by a stuffed toy. This was corrected when the caregiver removed the infant from the bouncer and held her to finish her bottle.
A bottle was propped during mealtime.

This standard was reviewed and found to be out of compliance through an investigation when it was determined caregivers propped a bottle to feed an infant who could not support the bottle on their own.
Bottle propping was observed for a younger child when the caregiver used a blanket to prop the bottle for the child during feeding time.
During the walkthrough of the infant room I observed an infant in a swing with a bottle propped with a blanket.
